metrics.measures_note: Area and volume are omitted: the faces self-intersect, so both depend on a convention (net area vs. density-weighted vs. outer solid region). Record them only alongside an explicit convention field.

geometry.orientation: inherited from its dual, reciprocated about the common midsphere
geometry.faces_wound: each face is its true winding cycle; windings are coherent (every edge traversed once in each direction)

provenance.coordinates: derived: polar reciprocal of Great Snub Dodecicosidodecahedron about their common midsphere
sources: E. Catalan, 'Memoire sur la theorie des polyedres', J. Ecole Polytechnique 41 (1865), 1-71.
Z. Har'El, 'Uniform Solution for Uniform Polyhedra', Geometriae Dedicata 47 (1993), 57-110 (dual names and prototiles).
